tags.chapter_name: Classification of Elements and Periodicity in Properties

question.text: The type of oxide formed by the element among $\mathrm{Li}, \mathrm{Na}, \mathrm{Be}, \mathrm{Mg}, \mathrm{B}$ and Al that has the least atomic radius is :

solution.text: Among given atoms, Boron has least atomic radius oxide of Boron $=\mathrm{B}_2 \mathrm{O}_3$
